h1: Custom Gray Apparel for Your Team
metaDescription: Order custom gray apparel for your team or event. Perfect for uniforms, giveaways, and bulk orders from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Gray apparel offers a neutral, professional base that pairs well with any logo color, from bold brights to subtle metallics. Whether you need heathered polo shirts for a company picnic or lightweight performance jackets for a safety team, gray provides a versatile canvas for screen printing or embroidery. Choose from adult and youth sizes in fleece, jersey, and performance fabrics to match your uniform needs.
heroAltText: Custom gray apparel including polo shirts and jackets for corporate uniforms and team events
